 Kaley Cuoco And Tom Pelphrey Embrace Family Tradition With Minion-Themed Halloween Costumes
 Actress Kaley Cuoco shared a glimpse into her family's Halloween celebrations, featuring coordinated Minion costumes with fiancé Tom Pelphrey and their two young daughters, Matilda and Philomena.
 Zoom TV Digital 
 Updated Nov 1, 2026, 21:35 IST
 Kaley Cuoco And Tom Pelphrey Embrace Family Tradition With Minion-Themed Halloween Costumes
 Kaley Cuoco has embraced a new holiday tradition, sharing a series of photos on social media that capture her family’s coordinated Halloween celebration. The actress, known for her roles in major television projects, posted images showing herself, her fiancé Tom Pelphrey, and their two daughters, Matilda and Philomena, dressed in matching Minion-themed jumpsuits.
 Reflecting on the experience in her caption, Cuoco noted a shift in her perspective regarding holiday festivities. She humorously admitted that she never anticipated becoming a parent who prioritizes family-themed costumes, but has fully leaned into the role, jokingly telling followers to hold her calls as she enjoys the moment.
 A Growing Family Milestone
The Halloween post follows the recent expansion of the couple's family. In October 2026, Cuoco and Pelphrey announced the arrival of their second daughter, Philomena Carmine Bobby Pelphrey. At the time of the birth, the couple shared their gratitude for the addition to their household, with Cuoco describing the experience as a blessing and Pelphrey referring to the newborn as a miracle. The couple’s journey together has been marked by several public milestones since they first confirmed their relationship at a Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony in May 2022. Following that initial public appearance, they announced they were expecting their first child just five months later. Their eldest daughter, Matilda, was born in March 2023, and the couple subsequently announced their engagement in 2024.
 Reflecting on Their Journey
In the announcement regarding Philomena’s birth, Cuoco expressed the significance of their growing family, noting that their lives had changed significantly since they first met. Pelphrey also shared his own series of images documenting the arrival of their second child, reinforcing the couple's public commitment to their life together. The family’s recent Halloween outing serves as one of the first glimpses of the family of four celebrating a holiday together following the birth of their youngest daughter. End of Article ZOOM NOW
